# Approved Personas for Agile Stories

> Never write "as a user" — always use a specific role from this list.

## 1) Engineering Personas

| Persona | Use When |
|---|---|
| Data engineer | Building or maintaining ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and batch/stream pipelines. |
| Analytics engineer | Modeling curated datasets, semantic layers, and metrics consumed by BI or reporting teams. |
| ML engineer | Developing model training/inference pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving integrations. |
| Platform architect | Defining cross-team technical patterns, platform standards, and system-level modernization work. |
| DevOps/DataOps engineer | Implementing CI/CD, infrastructure automation, environment reliability, and operational controls. |

## 2) Business & Stakeholder Personas

| Persona | Use When |
|---|---|
| Business analyst | Requesting trusted data outputs for analysis, planning, and decision support. |
| Product manager | Prioritizing product outcomes, delivery milestones, and customer-facing capability changes. |
| Finance analyst | Depending on reconciled and timely financial aggregates for period close and reporting. |
| Operations team | Needing stable workflows, alerting, and runbooks for day-to-day process continuity. |

## 3) System / Service Personas

| Persona | Use When |
|---|---|
| Downstream API consumer | Integrations depend on API contracts, payload stability, or response behavior. |
| Event stream subscriber | Services consume event topics and require schema stability and delivery guarantees. |
| BI tool | Dashboards/reports depend on dataset freshness, consistency, and governed semantic definitions. |
| Data contract validator | Automated checks enforce schema, quality, and compatibility between producer/consumer systems. |
